a: Hoshana! meikkara, name leassa "hoshana" karu leh.
Tanu rabbanan: sukka gezula, vehamesakkech birshut harabbim — rabbi eliezer posel, vachachamim machshirin.

Amar rav nachman: machloket beshettokef et chavero vehotzio missukkato. verabbi eliezer letameh deamar: en adam yotze yede chovato besukkato shel chavero. i karka nigzelet — sukka gezula hi. vei name karka enah nigzelet — sukka sheula hi.
Verabbanan letamayyhu, deamri: adam yotze yede chovato besukkato shel chavero, vekarka enah nigzelet, vesukka sheula hi.
Aval gazal etzim vesikkech bahen — divre hakkol en lo ella deme etzim.
Mimmay?
Middekatane: dumeya dirshut harabbim. ma reshut harabbim — karka lav dideh hu, sukka name — lav karka dideh hu.

Hahi savta daatay lekammeh derav nachman, amara leh: resh galuta vechullehu rabbanan deve resh galuta besukka gezula havo yatvi. tzavvcha vela ashgach bah rav nachman. amara leh: itteta dahava leh laavuha telat mea vetamne sere avde tzavvcha kammayychu vela ashgechitu ba?! amar lehu rav nachman: paita hi da, veen lah ella deme etzim bilvad.
Amar ravina: hay keshura dimtallalta digzula, avdi lay rabbanan takkanta, mishshum takkanat marish.
Peshita, may shena meetzim? mahu detema etzim shechichi, aval hay la shechicha — ema la, ka mashma lan.
Hane mille bego shiva, aval levatar shiva — hadar beeneh. vei chibbero betina, vaafillu leachar shiva name yahev leh deme.

Tana: yavesh — pasul, rabbi yehuda machshir. amar rava: machaloket belulav, derabbanan savri: makkeshinan lulav leetrog, ma etrog bae "hadar" — af lulav bae "hadar". verabbi yehuda savar: la makkeshinan lulav leetrog. aval beetrog — divre hakkol hadar baenan.
Uvelulav la bae rabbi yehuda "hadar"? vehatnan, rabbi yehuda omer: yaagdennu milmala. may tama — lav mishshum devae "hadar"?
La, kidkatane tama: rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi tarfon: "kappot temarim" — kefot, veim haya parud yichpetennu.
Vela bae "hadar"? vehatnan: en ogdin et hallulav ella bemino, divre rabbi yehuda. may tama, lav mishshum devae "hadar"?
La, deha amar rava: afillu besiv, vaafillu beikkara dedikla. [veella] may tama derabbi yehuda hatam? deka savar lulav tzarich eged, vei mayyte mina acharina — have lehu chamishsha minin.

Uveetrog mi bae rabbi yehuda hadar? vehatanya: arbaat minin shebballulav, keshem sheen pochatin mehen kach en mosifin alehen. lo matza etrog — lo yavi lo parish velo rimmon velo davar acher. kemushin — kesherin, yeveshin — pesulin. rabbi yehuda omer: af yeveshin.
Veamar rabbi yehuda: maase
b: Bivne cherakkin, shehayu morishin et lulevehen livne venehen! amru (lahem): mishsham reaya? en sheat haddechak reaya.
Katane mihat, rabbi yehuda omer: af yeveshin kesherin, may lav, aetrog! la, allulav.

Amar mar: keshem sheen pochatin mehen, kach en mosifin alehen. peshita? mahu detema: hoil veamar rabbi yehuda lulav tzarich eged, vei mayyte mina acharina, hay lechodeh kae vehay lechodeh kae, ka mashma lan.

Amar mar: lo matza etrog — lo yavi lo rimmon velo parish velo davar acher. peshita! mahu detema: layyte, ki hechi shello tishshachach torat etrog, ka mashma lan, zimnin denafek chureba minneh, deate lemisrach.
Ta shema: etrog hayyashan — pasul, verabbi yehuda machshir. teyuveta derava, teyuveta.
Vela bae hadar? veha anan tenan: hayyarok kecharate — rabbi meir machshir verabbi yehuda posel. lav mishshum devae hadar? la, mishshum dela gemar pera.
Ta shema: shiur etrog katan, rabbi meir omer: keegoz, rabbi yehuda omer: kevetza. lav mishshum devae hadar? la, mishshum dela gemar pera.

Ta shema: uvegadol kede sheyyeechoz shenayim beyado achat, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: afillu echad bishte yadav. may tama, lav mishshum devae hadar? la, kevan deamar rabba: lulav beyamin veetrog bismol, zimnin demichallefi leh veate leappuchinhu veate leippesole.
Veella lerabbi yehuda, ha ketiv "hadar"?
Hahu haddar beilano mishshana leshana.
Shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat. veshel ashera — pasul? vehaamar rava: lulav shel avoda zara — lo yittol, veim natal — kasher.
Hacha baashera demoshe askinan, dechattote meychattat shiureh.
Dayka name, dekatane: dumeya deir hanniddachat. shema minna.
Niktam rosho. amar rav huna: lo shanu ella niktam, aval nisdak — kasher.
Venisdak kasher? vehatanya: lulav kafuf,

a: Kavutz, saduk, akom dome lemaggal — pasul. charut — pasul. dome lecharut — kasher. amar rav pappa: daavid kehemnek.
Akom dome lemaggal, amar rava: la amaran ella lefanav, aval leacharav — biryayteh hu.
Amar rav nachman: litzdadin — kilfanav dame. veamri la: kilacharav dame.
Veamar rava: hay lulabba desalek bechad hutza — baal mum hu, ufasul.
Nifretzu alav kulei. amar rav pappa: nifretzu — deaved ki chufeya. nifredu — deipparud ipparode.
Bae rav pappa: nechleka hatteyomet, mahu? ta shema, deamar (rabbi yochanan) amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: nittela hatteyomet — pasul. may lav, hu haddin nechleka? la, nittela shane, deha chasar leh.
Ikka deamri: amar (rabbi yochanan) amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: nechleka hatteyomet, naasa kemi shennittela hatteyomet ufesul.
Rabbi yehuda omer. tanya, rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi tarfon: "kappot temarim" — kefot, im haya parud yichpetennu.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: mimmay dehay "kappot temarim" delulabba hu? ema charuta! baena kefot velekka.
Veema ufeta! "kefot" — mikkelal deikka parud, vehay kafut veomed leolam.
Veema kufera? amar abbaye: "deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom" ketiv.
Amar leh rava tosfaa leravina: veema tarte kappe detamre? "kappat" ketiv. veema chada? lehahu — "kaf" kare leh.
Tzinne har habbarzel — keshera. amar abbaye: lo shanu ella sherosho shel ze maggia letzad ikkaro shel ze, aval en rosho shel ze maggia letzad ikkaro shel ze — pasul.
Tanya name hachi: tzinne har habbarzel pesula. veha anan tenan keshera! ella shema minna keabbaye: shema minna.
b: Veikka derame lay mirme: tenan tzinne har habbarzel — kasher, vehatanya: pesula! amar abbaye, la kashya: kan — sherosho shel ze maggia letzad ikkaro shel ze, kan — sheen rosho shel ze maggia letzad ikkaro shel ze.

Amar rabbi mariyyon amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, veamri la tane rabba bar mari mishshum rabban yochanan ben zakkay: shete temarot yesh bege ben hinnom, veole ashan mibbenehem. vezehu sheshshaninu: tzinne har habbarzel kesherot, vezo hi pitchah shel gehinnam.
Lulav sheyyesh bo shelosha tefachim. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shiur hadas vaarava — shelosha, velulav — arbaa, kede sheyyehe lulav yotze min hahadas tefach.
Verabbi parnach amar rabbi yochanan: shidro shel lulav tzarich sheyyetze min hahadas tefach.
Tenan: lulav sheyyesh bo shelosha tefachim kede lenanea bo kasher. ema: uchede lenanea bo, kasher. mar kidit leh, umar kidit leh.
Ta shema: shiur hadas vaarava — shelosha, velulav — arbaa. may lav bahade alin! la, levad mealin.
Gufa: shiur hadas vaarava — shelosha, velulav — arbaa. rabbi tarfon omer: beamma bat chamishsha tefachim.
Amar rava: shera leh mareh lerabbi tarfon. hasheta avot shelosha la mashkechinan, bat chamishsha mibbaya!
Ki ata rav dimi, amar: amma bat shishsha tefachim ase otah bat chamishsha, tze mehen shelosha lahadas, vehashshear lallulav. kamma havu lehu — telata utelata chumeshe.

Kashya dishmuel addishmuel: hacha amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shiur hadas vaarava — shelosha, vehatam amar rav huna amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi tarfon! la dak. emar deamrinan la dak lechumera, lekulla mi amrinan la dak?!
Ki ata ravin, amar: amma bat chamishsha tefachim ase otah shishsha. tze mehen shelosha lahadas, vehashshear lallulav. kamma have lehu — tere ufalga.
Sof sof kashya dishmuel addishmuel! la dak, vehayeynu lechumera la dak. deamar rav huna amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi tarfon.

Mishna hadas haggazul vehayyavesh — pasul. shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat — pasul. niktam rosho, nifretzu alav, o shehayu anavav merubbot mealav — pasul. veim miatan — kasher, veen memaatin beyom tov.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "anaf etz avot" — sheanafav chofin et etzo. vee ze hu? heve omer ze hadas. veema zeta! baenan "avot", velekka.
Veema duleba! baenan anafav chofin et etzo, velekka.
Veema hirduf! amar abbaye: "deracheha darche noam", velekka. rava amar, mehacha: "haemet vehashshalom ehavu".
Tanu rabbanan: kalua kemin kelia vedome leshalshelet, zehu hadas. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: "anaf etz avot" — etz shettaam etzo ufiryo shave, heve omer ze hadas.
Tana: etz avot — kasher, vesheeno avot — pasul.

Hechi dame avot? amar rav yehuda: vehu dekayymi telata telata tarfe bekinna. rav kahana amar: afillu tere vechad. rav acha bereh derava mehaddar attere vechad, hoil unefayk mippummeh derav kahana. amar leh mar bar ammemar lerav ashe: abba lehahu — hadas shote kare leh.
Tanu rabbanan: nashru rov alav venishtayyeyru bo miut — kasher, uvilvad shettehe avoto kayyemet.
Ha gufa kashya: amrat nashru rov alav kasher, vahadar tane uvilvad shettehe avoto kayyemet. kevan denatri lehu tere, avot hechi mashkachat la?
Amar abbaye: mashkachat la

a: Beassa mitzraa dekayymi shiva shiva bechad kinna, dechi natri arbea, pashu lehu telata. amar abbaye: shema minna hay assa mitzraa kashar lehoshana.
Peshita! mahu detema hoil veit leh shem levavy, la mittachshar — ka mashma lan. veema hachi name! "etz avot" amar rachamana, mikkol makom.
Tanu rabbanan: yavshu rov alav venisharu bo shelosha badde alin lachin kasher. veamar rav chisda: uverosh kol echad veechad.
Niktam rosho. tane ulla bar chinnana: niktam rosho vealta bo temara — kasher.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: niktam rosho meerev yom tov vealta bo temara beyom tov, mahu? yesh dichuy etzel mitzvot, o lo?

Vetifshot leh meha ditnan: kissahu venitgalla — patur millechassot. kissahu haruach — chayyayv lechassot. veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella shechazar venitgalla, aval lo chazar venitgalla — patur millechassot.
Vehavenan bah: ki chazar venitgalla ammay chayyayv lechassot? hoil veiddechi iddechi!
Veamar rav pappa: zot omeret en dichuy etzel mitzvot.
Derav pappa gufa mibbaya leh: mifshayt peshit leh deen dichuy etzel mitzvot — la shena lekulla vela shena lechumera, o dilma sappoke mesappeka leh — lechumera amrinan, lekulla la amrinan. teku.

Lema ketannae: avar velikketan — pasul, divre rabbi elazar (ben) tzadok, vachachamim machshirin. savruha dechulle alma, lulav en tzarich eged. veim timtze lomar tzarich eged, la yalfinan lulav missukka dichtiv bah: "taase" — velo min heasuy.
May lav beha kamippalgi, deman defasel savar: amrinan yesh dichuy etzel mitzvot, uman demachshayr savar: la amrinan yesh dichuy etzel mitzvot?
La, dechulle alma la amrinan yesh dichuy etzel mitzvot, vehacha bemelaf lulav missukka ka mippalgi. mar savar: yalfinan lulav missukka, umar savar: la yalfinan lulav missukka.

Veibbaet ema: i sevira lan lulav tzarich eged, dechulle alma yalfinan lulav missukka, vehacha belulav tzarich eged ka mippalgi, uviflugeta dehane tannae, detanya: lulav, ben agud, ben sheeno agud — kasher, rabbi yehuda omer: agud — kasher, sheeno agud — pasul.

May tama derabbi yehuda? yalef "lekicha" "lekicha" meaguddat ezov. ketiv hacha: "ulekachtem lachem bayyom harishon", uchetiv hatam: "ulekachtem aguddat ezov". ma lehallan — agudda, af kan — agudda. verabbanan let lehu "lekicha" "lekicha".

Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: lulav mitzva leogdo, veim lo agado kasher. manni? i rabbi yehuda, ki lo agado ammay kasher? i rabbanan, may mitzva ka aved? leolam rabbanan, umitzva mishshum "ze eli veanvehu".
O shehayu anavav merubbin. amar rav chisda: davar ze, rabbenu haggadol amaro, vehammakom yihye beezro: lo shanu ella bemakom echad, aval bishnayim o shelosha mekomot — kasher.
Amar leh rava:
b: Shenayim ushelosha mekomot have menummar, ufesul.

Ella, i ittemar hachi ittemar: o shehayu anavav merubbin mealav — pasul. amar rav chisda: davar ze rabbenu haggadol amaro, vehammakom yihye beezro: lo shanu ella anavav shechorot. aval anavav yerukkot — mine dahadas hu, vechasher.
Amar rav pappa: adummot kishchorot damyayn, deamar rabbi chanina: hay dam shachor — adom hu, ella shellaka.
Im miatan — kasher. demaatinhu emat? illema mikkamme delogdeh — peshita! ella levatar delogdeh — dachuy meikkara hu! tifshot minna: dachuy meikkara — la have dachuy!
Leolam batar deagdeh, vekasavar: eged hazemana bealma hu, vehazemana bealma — lav kelum hu.
Veen memaatin beyom tov. ha avar velikketan may? kasher. deashchur emat? illema deashchur meetmol — dachuy meikkara hu. tifshot minna dachuy meikkara dela have dachuy!
Ella lav, deashchur beyom tov, nire venidche hu. shamat minna: nire venidche — chozer venire!
La, leolam deashchur meikkara, dachuy meikkara dela have dachuy tifshot minna, aval nire venidche chozer venire, la tifshot.
Tanu rabbanan: en memaatin beyom tov. mishshum rabbi eliezer berabbi shimon amru: memaatin. veha ka metakken mana beyom tov!
Amar rav ashe: kegon shellikketan laachila. verabbi eliezer berabbi shimon savar la kaavu, deamar: davar sheen mitkavven — muttar.
Veha abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut"!
Hacha bemay askinan — deit leh hoshana achariti.
Tanu rabbanan: huttar agdo beyom tov — ogdo kaagudda shel yarak. veammay? lineveh minav! ha manni rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: aniva — keshira meallayyta hi.
I rabbi yehuda, eged meallayyta bae! hay tanna savar la kevoteh bachada, ufelig aleh bachada.
Mishna arava gezula vivesha — pesula. shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat — pesula. niktam roshah, nifretzu aleha, vehatztzaftzafa — pesula. kemusha, veshennashru miktzat aleha, veshel baal — keshera.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "arve nachal" — haggedelin al hannachal. davar acher: "arve nachal", sheale shellah mashuch kenachal.
Tanya iddach: "arve nachal", en li ella arve nachal. shel baal veshel harim minnayin — talmud lomar: "arve nachal" mikkol makom.

a: Abba shaul omer: "arve" — shetayim. achat lallulav, veachat lammikdash.
Verabbanan, lammikdash mena lehu? hilcheta gemiri lehu. deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: eser netiot, arava venissuch hammayim — halacha lemoshe missinay.
Tanu rabbanan: "arve nachal" — haggedelot al hannachal, perat letzaftzafa haggedela ben heharim. amar rabbi zera, may keraa: "kach al mayim rabbim tzaftzafa samo".

Amar leh abbaye: vedilma paroshe ka mefaresh — "kach al mayim rabbim", umay nihu — tzaftzafa! im ken, may "samo"? amar rabbi avahu: amar hakkadosh baruch hu: ani amarti sheyyehu yisrael lefanay kekach al mayim rabbim", umay nihu — arava, vehen samu atzman ketzaftzafa shebbeharim.

Ikka dematne la lehay kera ammatnita: "kach al mayim rabbim tzaftzafa samo". matkef la rabbi zera: vedilma paroshe ka mefaresh "kach al mayim rabbim", may nihu — tzaftzafa! im ken — may "samo"? amar rabbi avahu: amar hakkadosh baruch hu: ani amarti sheyyehu yisrael lefanay kekach al mayim rabbim", umay nihu — arava, vehen samu atzman ketzaftzafa shebbeharim.

Tanu rabbanan: e zehu arava veezehu tzaftzafa? arava, kane shellah adom, veale shellah mashuch ufiha chalak. tzaftzafa, kane shellah lavan, veale shellah agol ufiha dome lemaggal. veha tanya: dome lemaggal kasher, dome lemassar — pasul! amar abbaye: ki tanya hahi, bechilfa gila.
Amar abbaye: shema minna hay chilfa gila — kasher lehoshana. peshita! mahu detema: hoil veit leh shem levavy la nittachshar, ka mashma lan.
Veema hachi name! "arve nachal" amar rachamana, mikkol makom.
Amar rav chisda: hane telat mille ishtanni shemayyhu mikki charav bet hammikdash: chalafta — aravta, aravta — chalafta. may nafka minna? lelulav.
Shippura — chatzotzarta, chatzotzarta — shippura. may nafka minna? leshofar shel rosh hashshana.
Patureta — patura, patura — patureta. lemay nafka minna? lemikkach umimkar.
Amar abbaye, af ani omer: be chase — huvelila, huvelila — be chase.
Lemay nafka minna? lemachat hannimtza beovi bet hakkosot.
Amar rava bar yosef, af ani omer: bavel — borsif, borsif — bavel. lemay
b: Nafka minna? legitte nashim.

Mishna rabbi yishmael omer: shelosha hadassim ushete aravot, lulav echad, veetrog echad. afillu shenayim ketumim, veechad eno katum. rabbi tarfon omer: afillu shelashtan ketumim. rabbi akiva omer: keshem shellulav echad veetrog echad — kach hadas echad vaarava achat.

Gemara tanya, rabbi yishmael omer: "peri etz hadar" — echad. "kappot temarim" — echad. "anaf etz avot" — shelosha. "arve nachal" — shetayim. vaafillu shenayim ketumim, veechad sheeno katum. rabbi tarfon omer: shelosha, vaafillu shelashtan ketumim. rabbi akiva omer: keshem shellulav echad veetrog echad, kach hadas echad vaarava achat.

Amar lo rabbi eliezer: yachol yehe etrog immahen baagudda achat? amarta, vechi neemar "peri etz hadar vechappot temarim"? vahalo lo neemar ella "kappot"! uminnayin shemmeakkevin ze et ze? talmud lomar: "ulekachtem" — shettehe lekicha tamma.
Verabbi yishmael, ma nafshach? i shelemin bae — live name kullehu, i la bae shelemin — afillu chad name la! amar biraa amar rabbi amme: chazar bo rabbi yishmael.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi tarfon. veazda shemuel letameh, daamar lehu shemuel lehanhu dimzabbene assa: ashvo vezabbinu, vei la — dareshna lechu kerabbi tarfon.
May tama? illema mishshum demekel — velidrosh lehu kerabbi akiva demekel tefe! telata ketimi shechichi, chad vela ketim la shechiach.

Mishna etrog haggazul vehayyavesh — pasul. shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat — pasul. shel orla — pasul. shel teruma temea — pasul. shel teruma tehora lo yittol, veim natal — kasher. shel demay — bet shammay poslin, uvet hillel machshirin. shel maaser sheni birushalayim — lo yittol, veim natal — kasher.

Alta chazazit al rubbo, nittela pitmato, niklaf, nisdak, nikkav vechasar kol shehu — pasul. alta chazazit al miuto, nittal uketzo, nikkav velo chasar kol shehu — kasher. etrog hakkushi — pasul, vehayyarok kecharate — rabbi meir machshir verabbi yehuda posel. shiur etrog hakkatan, rabbi meir omer: keegoz, rabbi yehuda omer kevetza. uvaggadol — kede sheyyochaz shenayim beyado. divre rabbi yehuda, verabbi yose omer: afillu echad bishte yadav.

a: Gemara tanu rabbanan: "peri etz hadar", etz shettaam etzo ufiryo shave — heve omer ze etrog.

Veema pilpelin; kidtanya, haya rabbi meir omer: mimmashma shenneemar "unetatem kol etz", eni yodea shehu etz maachol? ma talmud lomar "etz maachol", etz shettaam etzo ufiryo shave — heve omer ze pilpelin. lelammedcha shehappilpelin chayyayvin beorla. veen eretz yisrael chasera kelum, shenneemar: "lo techsar kol bah".
Hatam mishshum dela efshar, hechi naaved? ninkot chada — la minnachra lekichata. ninkot tere o telata — (echad) amar rachamana, velo shenayim ushelosha perot, hilkach la efshar.

Rabbi omer: al tikre "hadar", ella "haddir". ma dir ze yesh bo gedolim uketannim, temimim uvaale mumin — hachi name yesh bo gedolim uketannim, temimim uvaale mumin. attu shear perot let behu gedolim uketannim, temimin uvaale mumin?! ella hachi kaamar: ad shebbain ketannim, adayin gedolim kayyaymim.

Rabbi avahu amar: al tikre "hadar", ella "haddar" — davar sheddar beilano mishshana leshana. ben azzay omer: al tikre "hadar", ella "idor", shekken belashon yevoni korin lemayim idor, veezo hi sheggadel al kol mayim — heve omer ze etrog.
Shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat — pasul. may tama? kevan delisrefa kae — kattote meychattat shiureh.
Veshel orla pasul. may tama? peligi ba rabbi chiyyay bar avin verabbi assi. chad amar: lefi sheen bah hetter achila, vechad amar: lefi sheen bah din mamon.

Ka salka dateh man devae hetter achila la bae din mamon, uman devae din mamon la bae hetter achila. tenan: shel teruma temea — pesula, bishlama leman deamar lefi sheen bah hetter achila — shappir. ella leman deamar lefi sheen bah din mamon — ammay? hare massikah tachat tavshilo!
Ella: behetter achila kulle alma la peligi devaenan, ki peligi bedin mamon. mar savar: hetter achila baenan, din mamon la baenan, umar savar: din mamon name baenan. may benayyhu?

Ikka benayyhu maaser sheni shebbirushalayim. allibba derabbi meir, leman deamar lefi sheen bah hetter achila — hare yesh bah hetter achila, leman deamar lefi sheen bah din mamon — maaser sheni mamon gavoah hu.

Tistayyaym derabbi assi deamar lefi sheen bah din mamon. deamar rabbi assi: etrog shel maaser sheni, ledivre rabbi meir — en adam yotze bo yede chovato beyom tov, ledivre chachamim — adam yotze bo yede chovato beyom tov. tistayyaym.

Gufa. amar rabbi assi: etrog shel maaser sheni, ledivre rabbi meir — en adam yotze bo yede chovato beyom tov. ledivre chachamim — adam yotze bo yede chovato beyom tov. matztza shel maaser sheni, divre rabbi meir — en adam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach, ledivre chachamim — adam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach. issa shel maaser sheni, ledivre rabbi meir — petura min hachalla, ledivre chachamim — chayyevet bachalla.

Matkef la rav pappa: bishlama issa, ketiv: "reshit arisotechem". etrog name — ketiv: "lachem", mishshellachem. ella matztza, mi ketiv "matztzatchem"? amar rabba bar shemuel, veittema rav yemar bar shelemya: atya "lechem" "lechem". ketiv hacha "lechem oni", uchetiv hatam
b: "Vehaya baacholchem millechem haaretz". ma lehallan — mishshellachem velo mishshel maaser, af kan — mishshellachem velo mishshel maaser.
Lema mesayyay leh: issa shel maaser sheni petura min hachalla, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: chayyevet bachalla. lema mesayyay leh? hi hi!
Ella: middivha peligi — beha name peligi, o dilma: shane issa, deamar kera "arisotechem" "arisotechem" tere zimne.
Shel teruma temea pesula. delet bah hetter achila.
Veshel teruma tehora lo yittol. peligi ba rabbi amme verabbi assi, chad amar: mippene shemmachshirah, vechad amar: mippene shemmafsidah.
May benayyhu? kegon shekkara aleha shem chutz mikkelippatah chitzona. leman deamar mippene shemmachshirah — ikka. leman deamar mippene shemmafsidah — lekka.
Veim natal keshera. leman deamar mippene sheen bah hetter achila — hare yesh bah hetter achila, leman deamar lefi sheen bah din mamon — hare yesh bah din mamon.
Veshel demay. may tamayyhu devet hillel — kevan dei bae mafkar lehu lenichseh vehave ani vachaze leh, hasheta name "lachem" karena beh. ditnan: maachilin et haaniyyim demay veet achsanya demay.

Uvet shammay, ani la achel demay, ditnan: (en) maachilin haaniyyim demay veet haachsenaim demay, veamar rav huna: tana, bet shammay omrim: en maachilin et haaniyyim veet haachsenaim demay, uvet hillel omrim: maachilin et haaniyyim demay veet haachsenaim demay.
Shel maaser sheni shebbirushalayim. leman deamar mippene shemmachshirah — hare machshirah, leman deamar mippene shemmafsidah — hare mafsida.
Veim natal — keshera. leman deamar mippene sheen bah hetter achila — divre hakkol. leman deamar lefi sheen bah din mamon — ha manni rabbanan hi.

Alta chazazit. amar rav chisda: davar ze rabbenu haggadol amaro, hammakom yihye beezro: lo shanu ella bemakom echad, aval bishnayim ushelosha mekomot — kasher. amar leh rava: adderabba, bishnayim ushelosha mekomot have leh kimnummar, ufasul.

Ella: i ittemar assefa ittemar. al miuto — kasher. amar rav chisda: davar ze rabbenu haggadol amaro, vehammakom yihye beezro: lo shanu ella bemakom echad, aval bishnayim ushelosha mekomot — have leh kimnummar, ufasul. amar rava: veal chotmo — vaafillu bemashshehu name pasul.
Nittela pitmato. tana rabbi yitzchak ben elazar: nittela buchenato.
Niklaf. amar rava: hay etroga deagled kaahina summaka — keshera. veha anan tenan: niklaf — pasul! la kashya,

a: Ha bechulla, ha bemiktzata.
Nisdak, nikkav. tane ulla bar chanina: nikkav nekev mefullash — bemashshehu, vesheeno mefullash — bichissar.
Bae rava: noldu baetrog simane terefa, mahu? may kamibbaya leh? i niklaf — tenena! i nisdak — tenena! i nikkav — tenena!

Ki ka mibbaya leh kidulla amar rabbi yochanan: rea shennishpecha kekiton — keshera. veamar rava: vehu dekayymi simponaha. ha la kayymi simponaha — terefa. hacha may? dilma hatam hu dela shalet ba avvera, hadar barya, aval hacha deshalet ba avvera — saroche masrecha, o dilma la shena?

Ta shema: etrog tafuach saruach, kavush, shaluk, kushi, lavan, umenummar — pasul. etrog kechaddur — pasul, veyesh omrim: af hatteyom. etrog habboser — rabbi akiva posel, vachachamim machshirin. giddelo bidfus vaasao kemin beriyya acheret — pasul.
Katane mihat tafuach saruach, may lav: tafuach mibbachutz, vesaruach mibbifnim! la, idi veidi mibbachutz, vela kashya: ha ditfach af al gav dela serach, ha disrach af al gav dela tefach.
Amar mar: etrog kushi — pasul. vehatanya: kushi kasher, dome lechushi — pasul! amar abbaye: ki tenan name matnitin, dome lechushi tenan. rava amar: la kashya ha lan, veha lehu.

Etrog habboser — rabbi akiva posel vachachamim machshirin. amar rabba: rabbi akiva verabbi shimon amru davar echad. rabbi akiva — ha daamaran. rabbi shimon may hi — (detanya:) rabbi shimon poter et haetrogim bekotnan.
Amar leh abbaye: dilma la hi, ad kan la kaamar rabbi akiva hacha, devaenan "hadar" velekka, aval hatam — kerabbanan sevira leh.
I name, ad kan la kaamar rabbi shimon hatam, ella dichtiv: "asser teasser et kol tevuat zarecha", kederech shebbene adam motziin lizria. aval hacha, kerabbanan sevira leh.
b: Vetu la midde.

Giddelo bidfus vaasao kemin beriyya acheret — pasul. amar rava: lo shanu ella kemin beriyya acheret, aval kivriyyayto — kasher. peshita! kemin beriyya acheret (tenan)! la tzericha, daavida dappe dappe.
Ittemar etrog shennekavuhu achbarim, amar rav: en ze hadar. ini? veha rabbi chanina metabbel be venafek be! ulerabbi chanina kashya matnitin!
Bishlama matnitin lerabbi chanina la kashya: kan beyom tov rishon, kan beyom tov sheni. ella lerav kashya! amar lecha rav: shane achbarim dimisi.
Ikka deamri, amar rav: ze hadar, deha rabbi chanina metabbel be venafek be. ulerabbi chanina kashya matnitin! la kashya: kan beyom tov rishon, kan beyom tov sheni.

Etrog katan vechulei. amar rafram bar pappa: kemachloket kan, kach machloket baavanim mekurezalot. detanya: beshabbat shalosh avanim mekurezalot muttar lehachenis levet hakkisse, vechamma shiuran? rabbi meir omer: keegoz, rabbi yehuda omer: kevetza.
Uvaggadol kede sheyyochaz kulei. tanya, amar rabbi yose: maase berabbi akiva shebba levet hakkeneset veetrogo al ketefo! amar lo rabbi yehuda: mishsham reaya? af hem amru lo: en ze hadar.

Mishna en ogdin et hallulav ella bemino, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: afillu (bechut) bimshicha. amar rabbi meir: maase beanshe yerushalayim shehayu ogdin et lulevehen begimoniyyot shel zahav. amru lo: bemino hayu ogdin oto millematta.
Gemara amar rava: afillu besiv, afillu beikkara dedikla. veamar rava: may tameh derabbi yehuda, kasavar: lulav tzarich eged, vei mayyte mina acharina — have chamsha mine.

Veamar rava: mena amena la desiv veikkara dedikla mina delulabba hu — detanya: "bassukkot teshvu", sukka shel kol davar, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: en sukka noheget ella bearbaa minim shebballulav. vehaddin noten: uma lulav sheen noheg ballelot kevayyamim, eno noheg ella bearbaat minin, sukka shennoheget ballelot kevayyamim — eno din shello tehe ella bearbaat minin!
Amru lo: kol din sheatta dan techillato lehachemir vesofo lehakel — eno din.

a: Lo matza arbaat minin yehe yoshev uvatel, vehattora amra: "bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim" — sukka shel kol davar. vechen beezra omer: "tzeu hahar vehaviu ale zayit vaale etz shemen vaale hadas vaale temarim vaale etz avot (vaasu) sukkot kakkatuv"!
Verabbi yehuda savar: hane — lidfanot, ale hadas vaale temarim vaale etz avot — lischach. utenan: mesakkechin binsarin, divre rabbi yehuda. alma siv veikkara dedikla mina delulabba hu, shema minna.

Umi amar rabbi yehuda arbaat minin — in, midde acharina — la? vehatanya: sikkechah binsarim shel erez sheyyesh bahen arbaa tefachim — divre hakkol pesula. en bahen arbaa tefachim — rabbi meir posel, verabbi yehuda machshir. umode rabbi meir sheim yesh ben neser leneser kimlo neser — shemmanniach pesal benehen, ucheshera!
May "erez" — hadas, kidrabba bar rav huna. deamar rabba bar rav huna, amri be rav: asara mine arazim hen, shenneemar: "etten bammidbar erez shitta vahadas vegomer".

Rabbi meir omer afillu bimshicha kulei. tanya amar rabbi meir: maase beyakkire yerushalayim shehayu ogdin et lulevehen begimoniyyot shel zahav. amru lo: mishsham reaya?! bemino hayu ogdin oto millematta.
Amar lehu rabba lehanhu megaddele hoshana deve resh galuta: ki gadlitu hoshana deve resh galuta, shayyiru beh bet yad — ki hechi dela tehve chatzitza.
Rava amar: kol lenaoto — eno chotzetz. veamar rabba: la linkot inish hoshana besudara, devaena lekicha tamma velekka. verava amar: lekicha al yede davar acher — shemah lekicha.

Amar rava: mena amena la dilkicha al yede davar acher shemah lekicha, ditnan: ezov katzar — mesappeko bechut uvechush, vetovel umaale veochez baezov umazze. ammay — "velakach" "vetaval" amar rachamana! ella lav, shema minna: lekicha al yede davar acher — shemah lekicha.
Mimmay? dilma shane hatam, kevan dechabbereh — kegufeh dame. ella mehacha: nafal mishshefoferet lashshoket — pasul.
b: Ha hippilo hu — kasher. ammay? "velakchu" "venatan" amar rachamana! ella lav, shema minna: lekicha al yede davar acher — shemah lekicha.
Veamar rabba: la lidutz inish lulabba behoshana, dedilma natri tarfe vehave chatzitza. verava amar: min bemino eno chotzetz.
Veamar rabba: la liggoz inish lulabba behoshana, demishtayyeyri hutze vehave chatzitza. verava amar: min bemino eno chotzetz.

Veamar rabba: hadas shel mitzva — asur lehariach bo, etrog shel mitzva — muttar lehariach bo. may tama? hadas dilrecha kae, ki aktzeye — merecha aktzeye. etrog delaachila kae ki aktzeye — meachila aktzeye.

Veamar rabba: hadas bimchubbar — muttar lehariach bo, etrog bimchubbar — asur lehariach bo. may tama? hadas dilhariach kae, i sharet leh — la ate lemigzeyeh. etrog, delaachila kae, i sharet leh — ate lemigzeyeh.

Veamar rabba: lulav — beyamin, veetrog — bismol. may tama? hane telata mitzvot, vehay chada mitzva. amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zerika: may taam la mevarchinan ella "al netilat lulav" — hoil vegavoah mikkullan. velagbeheh leetrog ulevarech! amar leh: hoil uvemino gavoah mikkullan.

Mishna vehechan hayu menaanin? behodu laAdonai" techilla vasof, uveanna Adonai hoshia na" — divre bet hillel. uvet shammay omrin: af beanna Adonai hatzelicha na". amar rabbi akiva: tzofe hayiti berabban gamliel verabbi yehoshua, shekkol haam hayu menanein et lulevehen, vehem lo nanao ella beanna Adonai hoshia na".
Gemara ninua man dechar shemeh? hatam kae: kol lulav sheyyesh bo shelosha tefachim kede lenanea bo — kasher, vekaamar: hechan menanein.

Tenan hatam: shete hallechem ushene kivse atzeret ketzad hu ose? manniach shete hallechem al gabbe shene hakkevasin, umanniach yado tachtehen, umenif umolich umevi, maale umorid. shenneemar: "asher hunaf vaasher huram".

Amar rabbi yochanan: molich umevi lemi shehaarba ruchot shello, maale umorid lemi shehashshamayim vehaaretz shello. bemareva matnu hachi: amar rabbi chama bar ukeva amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: molich umevi kede laatzor ruchot raot, maale umorid kede laatzor telalim raim. amar rabbi yose bar avin veittema rabbi yose bar zevida: zot omeret

a: Sheyare mitzva meakkevin et happureanut. shehare tenufa sheyare mitzva hi — veotzeret ruchot utelalim raim. veamar rava: vechen belulav. rav acha bar yaakov mamte leh umayyte leh, amar: den gira beeneh desitna. velav milleta hi, mishshum deate leiggaroye beh.
Mishna mi shebba badderech velo haya beyado lulav littol — lichsheyyikkanes leveto, yittol al shulchano. lo natal shacharit — yittol ben haarbayim, shekkol hayyom kasher lelulav.
Gemara amrat, notlo al shulchano; lememra demafsek? ureminhi: im hitchilu — en mafsikin! amar rav safra: la kashya, ha — deikka shehut bayyom, ha — delekka shehut bayyom.

Amar rava: may kusheya? dilma ha deorayyta, ha derabbanan. ella amar rava: i kashya — ha kashya: lichsheyyikkanes leveto — notlo al shulchano, alma demafsek, vahadar tane: lo natal shacharit — yittol ben haarbayim. alma la mafsek!
Amar rav safra: la kashya, ha — deikka shehut bayyom, ha — delekka shehut bayyom.

Amar rabbi zera: may kusheya? dilma: mitzva leafsoke, vei la pesayk — yittol ben haarbayim, shekkol hayyom kasher lelulav. ella amar rabbi zera: leolam kidamrinan meikkara, udekashya lach ha deorayyta ha derabbanan — hacha beyom tov sheni derabbanan askinan.
Dayka name, middekatane: mi shebba badderech veen beyado lulav. dei salka datach beyom tov rishon — mi shere?!

Mishna mi shehaya eved o ishsha o katan makrin oto — one acharehen ma shehen omrin, vetavo lo meera. im haya gadol makre oto, one acharav "haleluyah". makom shennahagu lichpol — yichpol, lifshot — yifshot, levarech — yevarech, hakkol keminhag hammedina.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: beemet amru ben mevarech leaviv. veeved mevarech lerabbo, veishsha mevarechet levalah, aval amru chachamim: tavo meera leadam sheishto uvanav mevarchin lo.
Amar rava:
b: Hilcheta gibbarata ikka lemishma mimminhaga dehallela. hu omer: "haleluyah", vehen omrim: "haleluyah" — mikkan shemmitzva laanot "haleluyah".

Hu omer: "hallalu avde Adonai", vehen omrin: "haleluyah" — mikkan sheim haya gadol makre oto, one acharav "haleluyah". hu omer: "hodu laAdonai", vehen omrim: "hodu laAdonai" — mikkan shemmitzva laanot rashe ferakim. ittemar name, amar rav chanan bar rava: mitzva laanot rashe ferakim.
Hu omer: "ana Adonai hoshia na", vehen omrim: "anna Adonai hoshia na", — mikkan sheim haya katan makre oto, onin acharav ma shehu omer.
Hu omer: "ana Adonai hatzelicha na" vehen omrim: "anna Adonai hatzelicha na", mikkan sheim ba lichpol — kofel. hu omer: "baruch habba", vehen omrim: "beshem Adonai" — mikkan leshomea keone.
Beo minneh merabbi chiyyay bar abba: shama velo ana, mahu? amar lehu: chakkimayya vesafrayya vereshe amma vedarashayya amru: shama velo ana — yatza.

Ittemar name, amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: minnayin leshomea keone — dichtiv: "et (haddevarim) asher kara (yoshiyyahu)". vechi yoshiyyahu keraan? vahalo shafan keraan, dichtiv: "vayyikraehu shafan (et kol haddevarim haelle) lifne hammelech". ella, mikkan leshomea keone.

Vedilma batar dikranhu shafan kera yoshiyyahu? amar rav acha bar yaakov: la salka datach, dichtiv: "yaan rach levavcha vattikkana lifne Adonai beshomacha (et haddevarim haelle)" — "beshomacha" vela "bekoracha".
Amar rava: la lema inish "baruch habba" vahadar "beshem Adonai", ella "baruch habba beshem Adonai", bahadade. (amar leh rav safra:

a: Moshe, shappir kaamrat?! ella hatam vehacha assoke milleta hi, velet lan ba). amar rava: la lema inish "yehe shemeh rabba" vahadar "mevarach", ella "yehe shemeh rabba mevarach" bahadade. amar leh rav safra: moshe, shappir kaamrat?! ella, hatam vehacha assoke milleta hu, velet lan ba.
Makom shennahagu lichpol. tana: rabbi kofel bah devarim. rabbi elazar ben parta mosif bah devarim. may mosif? amar abbaye: mosif lichpol meodcha" ulematta.

Levarech — yevarech. amar abbaye: lo shanu ella leacharav, aval lefanav — mitzva levarech. deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol hammitzvot kullan, mevarech alehen over laasiyyaytan. umay mashma dehay "over", lishshana deakdome hu? deamar rav nachman bar yitzchak dichtiv: "vayyarotz achimaatz derech hakkikkar vayyaavor et hakkushi". abbaye amar, mehacha: "vehu avar lifnehem". veibbaet ema mehacha: "vayyaavor malkam lifnehem vaAdonai berosham".
Mishna hallokeach lulav mechavero bashsheviit — noten lo etrog bemattana, lefi sheen rashshay lelokcho bashsheviit.
Gemara lo ratza litten lo bemattana, mahu? amar rav huna: mavlay leh deme etrog belulav. velittev leh behedya?

Lefi sheen mosrin deme perot sheviit leam haaretz. detanya: en mosrin deme perot sheviit leam haaretz yoter mimmezon shalosh seudot. veim masar, yomar: hare maot hallalu yehu mechullalin al perot sheyyesh li betoch beti,
b: Uva veochlan bikdushshat sheviit.
Bamme devarim amurim — belokeach min hammufekar. aval belokeach min hameshummar, afillu bechachatzi issar — asur.

Metiv rav sheshet: umin hammufekar shalosh seudot vetu la? ureminhi: happegam vehayyarbuzin vehashshetim vachaloglogot vehakkusebar shebbeharim vehakkarpas shebbanneharot vehaggargir shel afar — peturin min hammaaser, venikkachin mikkol adam bashsheviit, lefi sheen kayyotze bahen nishmar.

Hu motev la vehu mefarek la: bichde man shanu. vechen amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: bichde man shanu. may mashma dehay "man" lishshana dimzone hu — dichtiv: "vayman lahem hammelech vegomer".
I hachi, lulav name! lulav bar shishshit hannichnas lishviit hu. i hachi etrog name — bat shishshit hannichneset lishviit hi! etrog, batar lekita azlinan.
Veha ben rabban gamliel uven rabbi eliezer, leinyan sheviit etrog batar chanata azlinan! ditnan: etrog shave lailan bishlosha derachim, velayyarak bederech echad.
Shave lailan bishlosha derachim — leorla velirvai velishviit. uleyarak bederech echad —

a: Shebbishat lekitato issuro, divre rabban gamliel. rabbi eliezer omer: etrog shave lailan lechol davar.
Hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya: amar rabbi yose: avtulemos heid mishshum chamishsha zekenim: etrog achar lekita lammaaser, verabbotenu nimnu beusha veamru ben lammaaser ben lashsheviit.

Sheviit man dechar shemeh? chassore michassera vehachi katane: etrog achar lekita lammaaser, veachar chanata lashsheviit. verabbotenu nimnu beusha veamru: etrog batar lekita, ben lammaaser ben lashsheviit.

Tama delulav bar shishshit hannichnas lishviit hu, ha dishviit kadosh, ammay? etzim bealma hu, veetzim en bahen mishshum kedushshat sheviit! (ditnan:) ale kanim vaale gefanim sheggibbevan lechubba al pene hassade, likketan laachila — yesh bahen mishshum kedushshat sheviit, likketan leetzim — en bahen mishshum kedushshat sheviit.
Shane hatam, deamar kera: "lachem leochla". "lachem" dumeya dilachla — mi shehanaato uviuro shave. yatzu etzim, shehanaatan achar biuran.
Vehaikka etzim demishchan, dahanaatan uviuran shave! amar rava: setam etzim, lehassaka hen omdin.
Veetzim lehassaka, tannae hi, detanya: en mosrin perot sheviit lo lemishra velo lichvusa. rabbi yose omer: mosrin.

May tameh detanna kamma — deamar kera: "leochla", velo lemishra velo lichvusa. may tameh derabbi yose — amar kera: "lachem", "lachem" lechol tzorchechem, vaafillu lemishra velichvusa. vetanna kamma, ha ketiv "lachem"! hahu "lachem" dumeya dilochla: mi shehanaato uviuro shave, yatzu mishra uchevusa — shehanaatan achar biuran.

Verabbi yose, ha ketiv "leochla"! hahu mibbee leh "leochla" velo limlugema. kidtanya: "leochla" — velo limlugema. atta omer "leochla" velo limlugema, o eno ella velo lichvusa? keshehu omer "lachem", hare lichvusa amur. ha ma ani mekayyem "leochla" — "leochla" velo limlugema. ma raita lerabbot et hakkevusa ulehotzi et hammelugema?
b: Merabbe ani et hakkevusa sheshshava bechol adam, umotzi et hammelugema sheenah shava lechol adam.
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: "leochla" — velo limlugema, "leochla" — velo lezilluf, "leochla" — velo laasot mimmenna appiktevizin? keman — kerabbi yose. dei rabbanan, ha ikka name mishra uchevusa.
Amar rabbi elazar: en sheviit mitchallelet ella derech mikkach. verabbi yochanan amar: ben derech mikkach ben derech chillul.

May tameh derabbi elazar? dichtiv: "bishnat hayyovel hazzot vegomer", usemich leh: "vechi timkeru mimkar", derech mikkach velo derech chillul. verabbi yochanan may tameh? dichtiv: "ki yovel hi kodesh". ma kodesh — ben derech mikkach ben derech chillul, af sheviit — ben derech mikkach ben derech chillul.

Verabbi yochanan, hay "ki timkeru mimkar" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidrabbi yose bar chanina. detanya, amar rabbi yose bar chanina: bo uree kamma kashe avakah shel sheviit vechulei. adam nose venoten beferot sheviit, lesof mocher et mittaltelav veet kelav, shenneemar: "bishnat hayyovel hazzot tashuvu ish el achuzzato", usemich leh: "vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha vegomer".
Verabbi elazar, hay kera derabbi yochanan may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidtanya: "ki yovel hi kodesh". ma kodesh tofes et damav — af sheviit tofeset et dameha.

Tanya kevoteh derabbi elazar, vetanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan. tanya kevoteh derabbi elazar: sheviit tofeset et dameha, shenneemar: "ki yovel hi kodesh tihye lachem", ma kodesh tofes et damav — veasur, af sheviit tofeset et dameha — vaasura.
I, ma kodesh tofes damav — veyotze lechullin, af sheviit tofeset et dameha — veyotzet lechullin? talmud lomar: "tihye", bahavayaytah tehe.

Ha ketzad? lakach beferot sheviit basar — ellu vaellu mitbaarin bashsheviit. lakach babbasar dagim — yatza basar venichnesu dagim. lakach baddagim yayin — yatzu dagim venichnas yayin. lakach bayyayin shemen — yatza yayin venichnas shemen.
Ha ketzad: acharon acharon nichnas bashsheviit, uferi atzmo asur. middekatane "lakach" "lakach", alma derech mikkach — in, derech chillul — la.

Tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan: echad sheviit veechad maaser sheni mitchallelin al behema chayya vaof, ben chayyin ben shechutin, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: al shechutin — mitchallelin, al chayyin — en mitchallelin, gezera shemma yegaddel mehen adarim.
Amar rava: machloket

a: Bizcharim, aval binkevot — divre hakkol: al shechutin — mitchallelin, al chayyin — en mitchallelin, gezera shemma yegaddel mehen adarim.
Amar rav ashe: machaloket bifri rishon, aval bifri sheni — divre hakkol: ben derech mikkach ben derech chillul. veha dekatane "lakach" "lakach", ayyeyde ditna resha "lakach", tena name sefa "lakach".

Etiveh ravina lerav ashe: mi sheyyesh lo sela shel sheviit uvikkesh likkach bo chaluk, ketzad yaase? yelech etzel chenvoni haragil etzlo, veomer lo: ten li besela perot, venoten lo, vechozer veomer lo: hare perot hallalu netunim lecha bemattana. vehu omer lo: he lecha sela zo bemattana, vehalla lokeach bahen ma sheyyirtze. veha hacha, difri sheni hu, vekatane: derech mikkach — in, derech chillul — la!
Ella amar rav ashe: machaloket bifri sheni, aval bifri rishon, divre hakkol: derech mikkach — in, derech chillul — la. veha dekatane: echad sheviit veechad maaser sheni — may sheviit? deme sheviit.
Dei la tema hachi, "maaser" — maaser mammash? veha ketiv: "vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha". ella deme maaser — hacha name deme sheviit.
Mishna barishona haya lulav nittal bammikdash shiva, uvammedina yom echad. mishshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyyehe lulav nittal bammedina shiva, zecher lammikdash.
Vesheyyehe yom henef kullo asur.

Gemara mena lan deavdinan zecher lammikdash? amar rabbi yochanan, deamar kera: "ki aale arucha lach umimmakkotayich erpaech neum Adonai ki niddacha karu lach tziyyon hi doresh en lah". "doresh en lah", mikkelal devaaya derisha.

Vesheyyehe yom henef. may tama? mehera yibbane bet hammikdash, veyomru: eshtakad mi lo achalnu beheir mizrach? hasheta name nechol. veinhu la yadi deeshtakad dela hava bet hammikdash — heir mizrach, hittir. hasheta deikka bet hammikdash — omer mattir.

Deibbeni emat? illema deibbeni beshittesar, hare hittir heir mizrach! ella deibbeni bachamesar, mechatzot hayyom ulehallan tishtere, deha tenan: harchokim, muttarin mechatzot hayyom ulehallan, lefi sheen bet din mitatztzelim bo!
La tzericha, deibbeni belelya, i name samuch lishkiat hachamma. (amar) rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: rabban yochanan ben zakkay beshitat rabbi yehuda amarah, deamar: min hattora hu asur, dichtiv:
b: "Ad etzem hayyom hazze" — ad itztzumo shel yom, vekasavar "ad" vead bakkelal.

Umi savar leh kevoteh? veha miflayg pelig aleh, (detanya:) mishshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyyehe yom henef kullo asur, amar lo rabbi yehuda: vahalo min hattora hu asur, dichtiv: "ad etzem hayyom hazze" — ad itztzumo shel yom!
Rabbi yehuda hu deka tae, hu savar midderabbanan kaamar. vela hi, middeorayyta kaamar. veha "hitkin" kaamar! may "hitkin" — darash vehitkin.

Mishna yom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot beshabbat, kol haam molichin et lulevehen levet hakkeneset. lammochorat mashkimin uvain, kol echad veechad makkir et shello venotlo, mippene sheamru chachamim: en adam yotze yede chovato beyom tov harishon belulavo shel chavero, ushear yemot hachag — adam yotze yede chovato belulavo shel chavero. rabbi yose omer: yom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot beshabbat, veshachach vehotzi et hallulav lirshut harabbim — patur, mippene shehotzio birshut.

Gemara mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "ulekachtem", shettehe lekicha beyad kol echad veechad. "lachem", mishshellachem — lehotzi et hashshaul veet haggazul. mikkan amru chachamim: en adam yotze yede chovato beyom tov harishon shel chag belulavo shel chavero ella im ken netano lo bemattana.

Umaase berabban gamliel verabbi yehoshua verabbi elazar ben azarya verabbi akiva shehayu bain bisfina, velo haya lulav ella lerabban gamliel bilvad, shellekacho beelef zuz. netalo rabban gamliel veyatza bo, unetano lerabbi yehoshua bemattana. netalo rabbi yehoshua veyatza bo, unetano lerabbi elazar ben azarya bemattana. netalo rabbi elazar ben azarya veyatza bo, unetano bemattana lerabbi akiva. netalo rabbi akiva veyatza bo, vehechziro lerabban gamliel.
Lema li lememar hechziro? milleta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan: mattana al menat lehachezir — shemah mattana.
Ki ha deamar rava: "he lecha etrog ze al menat shettachzirehu li". netalo veyatza bo, hechziro — yatza, lo hechziro — lo yatza.
Lema li lememar shellekacho beelef zuz? lehodiacha kamma mitzvot chavivot alehen.

Amar leh mar bar ammemar lerav ashe: abba tzalloye ka metzalle beh. metivi: lo yochaz adam tefillin beyado vesefer tora becheko veyitpallel. velo yashtin bahen mayim, velo yishan bahen lo shenat keva velo shenat aray.
Veamar shemuel: sakkin ukeara, kikkar umaot — hare ellu kayyotze bahen. hatam lav mitzva ninhu, uterid behu. hacha mitzva ninhu, vela terid behu.

Tanya, rabbi elazar bar tzadok omer: kach haya minhagan shel anshe yerushalayim, adam yotze mibbeto — velulavo beyado. holech levet hakkeneset — lulavo beyado. kore keriat shema umitpallel — velulavo beyado. kore battora venose et kappav — mannicho al gabbe karka. holech levakker cholim ulenachem avelim — lulavo beyado. nichnas levet hammidrash — meshagger lulavo beyad beno, uveyad avdo, uveyad shelucho.
May ka mashma lan? lehodiacha kamma hayu zerizin bemitzvot.
Rabbi yose omer yom tov. amar abbaye:

a: Lo shanu ella shello yatza bo, aval yatza bo — chayyayv. ha middeagbeheh nefak beh! amar abbaye: keshehafacho.

Rava amar: afillu tema shello hafacho, hacha bemay askinan: kegon shehotzio bichli. veha rava hu deamar: lekicha al yede davar acher — shemah lekicha! hane mille derech kavod, aval derech bizzayon — la.
Amar rav huna: omer haya rabbi yose, olat haof shennimtzet ben agappayim, uchesavur chattat haof hi vaachalah — patur. may ka mashma lan, detaa bidvar mitzva — patur? hayeynu hach!
Mahu detema: hatam hu detaa bidvar mitzva patur — hayeynu daavad mitzva. aval hacha, detaa bidvar mitzva vela avad mitzva — ema la, ka mashma lan.
Metivi, rabbi yose omer: hashshochet et hattamid sheeno mevukkar kehilchato bashshabbat — chayyayv chattat, vetzarich tamid acher!
Amar leh: bar minna dehahi. deha ittemar ala, amar rav shemuel bar chattay amar rav hamenuna sava amar rav yitzchak bar ashyan amar rav huna amar rav: kegon shehevio millishka sheenan mevukkarin.
Mishna mekabbelet ishsha miyyad benah umiyyad balah, umachzirato lemayim beshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer: bashshabbat machzirin, beyom tov mosifin, uvammoed machlifin.
Katan hayyodea lenanea — chayyayv belulav.
Gemara peshita? mahu detema: hoil veishsha lav bat chiyyuva hi, ema la tekabbel, ka mashma lan.

Katan hayyodea lenanea. tanu rabbanan: katan hayyodea lenanea — chayyayv belulav, lehitattef — chayyayv betzitzit, lishmor tefillin — aviv lokeach lo tefillin, yodea ledabber — aviv melammedo tora ukeriat shema.
Tora may hi? amar rav hamenuna: "tora tzivva lanu moshe morasha kehillat yaakov". keriat shema may hi? pasuk rishon.

Hayyodea lishmor gufo — ochlin al gufo teharot. lishmor et yadav — ochlin al yadav teharot. hayyodea lishshael, birshut hayyachid — sefeko tame, birshut harabbim — sefeko tahor. hayyodea lifros kappav — cholkin lo teruma bevet haggoranot.
b: Hayyodea lishchot — ochlin mishshechitato. amar rav huna: vehu sheggadol omed al gabbav.

Yachol leechol kezayit dagan — marchikin mitztzoato umimmeme raglav arba ammot. amar rav chisda: vehu sheyyachol leochlo bichde achilat peras. amar rav chiyyay bereh derav yeva: uvaggadol, af al pi sheeno yachol leechol bichde achilat peras — dichtiv: "veyosif daat yosif machov".
Yachol leechol kezayit tzali — shochatin alav et happesach, shenneemar: "ish lefi ochlo". rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyachol levarer achila. ketzad? notnin lo tzeror — vezorko, egoz — venotlo.
Hadaran alach lulav haggazul
Lulav vaarava — shishsha veshiva. hahallel vehassimcha — shemona. sukka venissuch hammayim — shiva. hechalil — chamishsha veshishsha.
Lulav shiva, ketzad? yom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot bashshabbat — lulav shiva, ushear kol hayyamim — shishsha.
Arava shiva, ketzad? yom hashshevii shel arava shechal lihyot bashshabbat — arava shiva, ushear kol hayyamim — shishsha.

Mitzvat lulav, ketzad (bashshabbat)? yom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot bashshabbat molichin et lulevehen lehar habbayit, vehachazzanin mekabbelin mehen vesodrin otan al gabbe itzteva, vehazzekenim mannichin et shellahen belishka. umelammedin otam lomar: kol mi shemmaggia lulavi leyado — hare hu lo bemattana.
Lemachar mashkimin uvain, vehachazzanin zorkin otam lifnehem, vehen mechattefin umakkin ish et chavero. uchesherau bet din shebbau lide sakkana — hitkinu sheyyehe kol echad veechad notel beveto.
Gemara ammay? tiltul bealma hu, velidche shabbat! amar rabba: gezera shemma yittelennu beyado veyelech etzel baki lilmod,

a: Veyaavirennu arba ammot birshut harabbim. vehayeynu tama deshofar, vehayeynu tama dimgilla.
I hachi yom rishon name! rishon, ha takkinu le rabbanan beveto. hatinach achar takkana, kodem takkana may ikka lememar!
Ella, rishon deiteh min hattora bigvulin — la gezaru behu rabbanan. hanach deletanhu min hattora bigvulin — gezaru behu rabbanan.
I hachi, haiddana name! anan la yadinan bekibbua deyarcha. inhu, deyadi bekibbua deyarcha, lidcho!

In hachi name. (detane) chada: beyom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot beshabbat kol haam molichin et lulevehen lehar habbayit, (vetanya) iddach: levet hakkeneset. shema minna: kan — bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, kan — bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym. shema minna.
Deiteh min hattora bigvulin mena lan? detanya: "ulekachtem". shettehe lekicha beyad kol echad veechad.
"Lachem" — mishshellachem, lehotzi et hashshaul veet haggazul. "bayyom" — vaafillu bashshabbat. "rishon" — afillu bigvulin. "harishon" — melammed sheeno doche ella yom tov harishon bilvad.

Amar mar: "bayyom" — vaafillu bashshabbat. mikkede tiltul bealma hu, itzterich kera lemishre tiltul? amar rava: lo nitzrecha ella lemachshire lulav, veallibba dehay tanna, detanya: lulav vechol machshirav dochin et hashshabbat, divre rabbi eliezer.

May tama derabbi eliezer? amar kera: "bayyom", vaafillu bashshabbat. verabbanan —hay bayyom may avdi leh? mibbee leh: "bayyom", velo ballayla. verabbi eliezer "bayyom" velo ballayla mena leh? nafka leh missefa dikra: "usemachtem lifne Adonai elohechem shivat yamim" — yamim velo lelot. verabbanan — i mehatam hava amena: lelaf "yamim" "yamim" missukka. ma lehallan — yamim vaafillu lelot, af kan name yamim — vaafillu lelot.

Vesukka gufa menalan? detanu rabbanan: "bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim", "yamim" — vaafillu lelot. atta omer "yamim" — vaafillu lelot, o eno ella "yamim" velo lelot? vedin hu: neemar kan "yamim", veneemar belulav "yamim", ma lehallan — "yamim" velo lelot, af kan — "yamim" velo lelot.
O kelach ladderech zo: neemar kan "yamim" veneemar bemilluim "yamim". ma lehallan — "yamim" vaafillu lelot, af kan — "yamim" vaafillu lelot.

Nire lemi dome: danin davar shemmitzvato kol hayyom middavar shemmitzvato kol hayyom, veal yochiach davar shemmitzvato shaa achat. o kelach lederech zo: danin davar shemmitzvato ledorot middavar shemmitzvato ledorot, veal yochichu milluim sheen nohagin ledorot.
Talmud lomar:
b: "Teshvu" "teshvu" — ligzera shava. neemar kan "teshvu", veneemar bemilluim "teshvu". ma lehallan — "yamim" vaafillu lelot, af kan — "yamim" vaafillu lelot.
Arava shiva. ketzad? arava bishvii may tama dachaya shabbat? amar rabbi yochanan: kede lefarsemah shehi min hattora. i hachi, lulav name lidche, kede lefarsemo shehu min hattora!
Lulav — gezera mishshum derabba. i hachi, arava name nigzor! arava — sheluche bet din mayyti la. lulav — lakkol masur.
I hachi, kol yoma name lidche! ate lefakpoke belulav. velidche beyom tov rishon! la mochcha milleta, amri: lulav hu deka dache.
Velidche bechad mehanach? kevan deka mappekat la merishon, okma ashshevii.
I hachi, haiddana name lidche! anan la yadinan bekibbua deyarcha.
Inhu, deyadi bekibbua deyarcha — lidche! ki ata bar hedya, amar: la ikkela. ki ata ravin vechol nachote, amri: ikkela vela dache.
Veella kashya? amar rav yosef: man lema lan daarava bintila? dilma bizkifa!
Etiveh abbaye: lulav vaarava shishsha veshiva. may lav, kelulav: ma lulav bintila — af arava bintila! midde irya? ha kiditeh veha kiditeh.

Etiveh abbaye: bechol yom makkifin et hammizbeach paam achat, veoto hayyom sheva peamim. may lav, baarava? la, belulav. veha amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: baarava! amar leh: hu amar lach baarava, vaana amena belulav. ittemar rabbi elazar omer: belulav. rav shemuel [bar natan] amar rabbi chanina: baarava. vechen amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: baarava.

Amar leh rava lerav yitzchak bereh derabba bar bar chana: bar ureya, ta veema lach milleta meallayta dahava amar avuch. ha ditnan: kol hayyom makkifin et hammizbeach paam achat, veoto hayyom makkifin et hammizbeach sheva peamim, hachi amar avuch mishshemeh derabbi elazar: belulav.

Etiveh: lulav doche et hashshabbat bitchillato, vaarava besofo. paam achat chal shevii shel arava lihyot bashshabbat, veheviu murbiyyot shel arava meerev shabbat vehinnichum baazara. vehikkiru bahen bayytosin, unetalum uchevashum tachat avanim.
Lemachar hikkiru bahen amme haaretz, ushematum mittachat haavanim, vahavium hakkohanim uzekafum betzidde hammizbeach. lefi sheen bayytosin modim shechibbut arava doche et hashshabbat.
Alma bintila hi! teyuveta.
Veella nidcho! kevan daanan la dachenan, inhu name la dachu. veha yom tov harishon, dildidan la dache uledidahu dache!

a: Amri: ledidhu name la dache. veella kashya hane tarte; detana chada: kol haam molichin et lulevehen lehar habbayit, vetanya iddach: levet hakkeneset, umetartzinan: kan — bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, kan — bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym.
La, idi veidi bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, vela kashya: kan — bammikdash, kan — baggevulin.

Amar leh abbaye lerava: may shena lulav deavdinan leh shiva zecher lammikdash, umay shena arava dela avdinan la shiva zecher lammikdash? amar leh: hoil veadam yotze yede chovato baarava shebballulav. amar leh: hahu mishshum lulav hu deka aved lay. vechi tema deka magba lay vahadar magba lay, veha maasim bechol yom dela ka avdinan hachi!
Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava: lulav deorayyta — avdinan shiva zecher lammikdash, arava derabbanan — la avdinan la shiva zecher lammikdash.

Leman? ilema abba shaul, haamar "arve nachal" ketiv — shetayim, achat lallulav veachat lammikdash. i lerabbanan, hilcheta gemiri la, deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi nechuneya ish bikat bet chortan: eser netiot, arava, venissuch hammayim — halacha lemoshe missinay.

Ella, amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava: lulav deit leh ikkar min hattora, — baggevulin avdinan leh shiva zecher lammikdash, arava delet la ikkar min hattora — baggevulin la avdinan shiva zecher lammikdash.

Amar resh lakish: kohanim baale mumin nichnasin ben haulam velammizbeach, kede latzet baarava. amar leh rabbi yochanan: mi amarah? mi amarah?! ha ihu amar! deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi nechuneya ish bikat bet chortan: eser netiot, arava, venissuch hammayim — halacha lemoshe missinay.
Ella: mi amarah bintila, dilma bizkifa! mi amarah bevaale mumin, dilma bitmimim!

Ittemar: rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi, chad amar: arava yesod neviim, vechad amar: arava minhag neviim. tistayyaym derabbi yochanan hu deamar yesod neviim, deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: arava yesod neviim hu. tistayyaym.

Amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi avahu: mi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi nechuneya ish bikat bet chortan: eser netiot, arava, venissuch hammayim — halacha lemoshe missinay? eshtomam keshaa chada vaamar, shechechum vechazru veyissedum.
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: dilchon amari: dilhon hi! la kashya:
b: Kan bammikdash — kan baggevulin.

Amar rabbi amme: arava tzericha shiur, veenah nittelet ella bifne atzmah, veen adam yotze yede chovato baarava shebballulav. kevan deamar mar enah nittelet ella bifne atzmah, peshita deen adam yotze baarava shebballulav!

Mahu detema: hane mille hecha dela agbehay vahadar agbehay, aval agbehay vahadar agbehay — ema la, ka mashma lan. verav chisda amar rabbi yitzchak: adam yotze yede chovato baarava shebballulav (beyom tov harishon shel chag).
Vechamma shiurah? amar rav nachman: shelosha badde alin lachin. verav sheshet amar: afillu ale echad uvad echad. ale echad uvad echad salka datach?! ella ema: afillu ale echad bevad echad.

Amar ayyvu: hava kaemna kammeh derabbi elazar bar tzadok veayyti hahu gavra arava kammeh. shakel, chabbet chabbet, vela barech. kasavar minhag neviim hu. ayyvu vechizkiyya bene veratte derav ayyto arava lekammeh derav, chabbet chabbet, vela barech. ka savar minhag neviim hu.

Amar ayyvu: hava kaemna kammeh derabbi elazar bar tzadok, ata lekammeh hahu gavra, amar leh: kiryayta it li, karmayya it li, zetayya it li, veatu bene kiryayta umekashkeshin becharmayya veochlin bezetayya — arich o la arich? amar leh: la arich. hava ka shavek leh veazel. amar: kedu haveti dayayr beara hada arbein shenin, vela chameti bar inash mehallech bearchan detaknan keden. hadar veate veamar leh: may mebad? amar leh: afkar zetayya lechashochayya, veten peritayya lekashkoshe keramim.

Vekashkoshe mi shere? veha tanya: "vehashsheviit tishmetenna unetashtah". "tishmetenna" — millekashkesh, "unetashtah" — millesakkel! amar rav ukeva bar chama: tere kishkushe havu. chad — sattome pile, vechad — avroye ilane. avroye ilane — asur, sattome pile — shere.
Amar ayyvu mishshum rabbi elazar bar tzadok: al yehallech adam bearve shabbatot yoter mishshalosh parsaot. amar rav kahana: la amaran ella leveteh, aval leushepizeh — ammay denaket semich.
Veikka deamri, amar rav kahana: lo nitzrecha ella afillu leveteh. amar rav kahana: bedidi hava ovada, vaafillu kasa deharsana la ashkachi.
Mitzvat lulav ketzad? tane tanna kammeh derav nachman: sudarin al gag haitzteva. amar leh:

a: Vechi leyaybshan hu tzarich? ella ema: al gav haitzteva. amar rachava amar (rav) yehuda: har habbayit setav kaful haya, setav lefanim missetav.

Mishna mitzvat arava ketzad? makom haya lematta mirushalayim venikra "motza", yordin lesham umelakketin mishsham murebiyyot shel arava, uvain vezokfin otan betzidde hammizbeach, verashehen kefufin al gabbe hammizbeach. taku veheriu vetaku. bechol yom makkifin et hammizbeach paam achat veomrim: "anna Adonai hoshia na, anna Adonai hatzelicha na". rabbi yehuda omer: "ani vahu hoshia na". veoto hayyom makkifin et hammizbeach sheva peamim. bishat petiratan ma hen omrim: "yofi lecha mizbeach, yofi lecha mizbeach!" rabbi elazar omer: "leyah ulecha mizbeach, leyah ulecha mizbeach".

Kemaasehu bachol kach maasehu bashshabbat, ella shehayu melakketin otan meerev umannichin otan begigiyyot shel zahav, kede shello yichmoshu. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: chariyyot shel dekel hayu meviin, vechovtin otan bekarka betzidde hammizbeach, veoto hayyom nikra chibbut chariyyot. miyyad tinokot shomtin et lulevehen veochlin etrogehen.
Gemara tana: mekom kalanya hava. vetanna didan may tama kare leh "motza"? ayyeyde demippak mikkeraga demalka — kare leh "motza".
Uvain vezokfin otan betzidde kulei. tana: rabbot, vaaruchot, ugevohot achat esre amma, kede sheyyehu gochot al hammizbeach amma.

Amar marimar mishshum mar zutera: shema minna al hayyesod mannach lehu, dei salka datach aara mannach lehu, mikkede: ala amma vechanas amma — zehu yesod. ala chamesh vechanas amma — zehu sovev. ala shalosh — zehu mekom hakkeranot. gochot al gabbe hammizbeach hechi mashkachat la! ella lav, shema minna ayyesod mannach lehu. shema minna.

Amar rabbi avahu: may keraa, shenneemar: "isru chag baavotim ad karnot hammizbeach". amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar: kol hannotel lulav beiggudo vahadas baavoto, maale alav hakkatuv keillu bana mizbeach vehikriv alav korban, shenneemar:
b: "Isru chag baavotim ad karnot hammizbeach". amar rabbi yirmeya mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay, verabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon hammachozi mishshum rabbi yochanan hammachoti: kol haose issur lechag baachila ushetiyya, maale alav hakkatuv keillu bana mizbeach vehikriv alav korban, shenneemar: "isru chag baavotim ad karnot hammizbeach".
Amar chizkiyya amar rabbi yirmeya mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: kol hammitzvot kullan en adam yotze bahen ella derech gedilatan, shenneemar: "atze shittim omdim".

Tanya name hachi: "atze shittim omdim" — sheomdim derech gedilatan. davar acher: "omdim" — shemmaamidin et tzippuyan. davar acher: "omdim" — shemma tomar avad sivram uvatal sikkuyayn, talmud lomar: "atze shittim omdim" — sheomdim leolam uleolme olamim.

Veamar chizkiyya amar rabbi yirmeya mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: yachol ani liftor et kol haolam kullo min haddin — miyyom shennivreti ad atta, veilmale eliezer beni immi — miyyom shennivra haolam vead achshav, veilmale yotam ben uzziyyahu immanu — miyyom shennivra haolam ad sofo.

Veamar chizkiyya amar rabbi yirmeya mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: raiti bene aliyyay vehen muatin. im elef hen — ani uveni mehen, im mea hem — ani uveni mehen, im shenayim hen — ani uveni hen. umi zutere kulle hay? veha amar rava: tamne sere alfe have dara dekammeh kudesha berich hu, shenneemar: "saviv shemona asar alef"! la kashya: ha demistakkeli beaspaklarya hammeira, ha dela mistakkeli beaspaklarya hammeira.

Udemistakkeli beaspaklarya hammeira, mi zutere kulle hay? veha amar abbaye: la pachet alma mittelatin veshitta tzaddike dimkabbeli appe shechina bechol yom, shenneemar: "ashre kol choche lo", "lo" begimatriyya telatin veshitta havu! la kashya: ha deayyli bevar, ha deayyli bela bar.

Bishat petiratan ma hen omrim vechulei. veha ka mishtattaf shem shamayim vedavar acher, vetanya: kol hameshattef shem shamayim vedavar acher neekar min haolam, shenneemar: "bilti laAdonai levaddo"! hachi kaamar: leyah anachnu modim, velach anu meshabbechin. leyah anachnu modim, velach anu mekallesin.
Kemaasehu bachol. amar rav huna: may tama derabbi yochanan ben beroka, dichtiv: "kappot", shenayim: achat lallulav veachat lemizbeach. verabbanan amri: "kappat" ketiv.
Rabbi levi omer, ketamar: ma tamar ze en lo ella lev echad, af yisrael en lahem ella lev echad laavihem shebbashshamayim.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lulav shiva, vesukka yom echad. may tama? lulav demafseki lelot miyyamim, kol yoma mitzva beappeh nafsheh hu. sukka dela mafseki lelot miyyamim, kullehu shiva kechad yoma aricha damu.
Verabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: sukka shiva, velulav yom echad. may tama? sukka deorayyta — shiva, lulav derabbanan — saggi leh bechad yoma.
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: echad ze veechad ze shiva. amar rav yosef: nekot derabba bar bar chana bidach, dechullehu amorae kayymi kevoteh besukka.
Metivi:

a: Haose lulav leatzmo, omer: "baruch ... shehecheyaynu vekiyyeymanu vehiggianu lizman hazze". netalo latzet bo, omer: "baruch ... asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al netilat lulav". veaf al pi shebberach alav yom rishon, chozer umevarech kol shiva. haose sukka leatzmo, omer: "baruch ... shehecheyaynu vekiyyeymanu kulei", nichnas leshev bah, omer: "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu leshev bassukka", vechevan shebberach yom rishon — shuv eno mevarech.
Kashya lulav allulav, kashya sukka assukka!
Bishlama lulav allulav la kashya: kan bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, kan bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym. ella sukka assukka kashya!
Tannae hi. detanya: tefillin, kol zeman shemmannichan — mevarech alehen, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: eno mevarech ella shacharit bilvad.

Ittemar, abbaye amar: hilcheta kerabbi, verava amar: hilcheta kerabbanan. amar rav mari bera devat shemuel: chazena leh lerava dela aved kishmateh, ella makdem vekae veayel bet hakkisse, venafek umashe yedeh umannach tefillin umevarech. vechi itzterich zimna acharina, ayel levet hakkisse, venafek umashe yedeh umannach tefillin umevarech, vaanan name kerabbi avdinan, umevarchin kol shiva.
Amar mar zutera: chazena leh lerav pappe, dechol emat demannach tefillin mevarech. rabbanan deve rav ashe, kol emat dim[ma]shemshi behu mevarchi.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mitzvat lulav kol shiva. verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: yom rishon — mitzvat lulav, mikkan veelach mitzvat zekenim. verabbi yitzchak amar: kol yoma mitzvat zekenim. vaafillu yom rishon?! veha kayyma lan deyom rishon deorayyta! ema: bar miyyom rishon. i hachi — hayeynu derabbi yehoshua ben levi! ema: vechen amar rabbi yitzchak.

Veaf rav savar: kol shiva mitzvat lulav. deamar rabbi chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: hammadlik ner shel chanukka — tzarich levarech. rabbi yirmeya amar: haroe ner shel chanukka — tzarich levarech. may mevarech? amar rav yehuda: yom rishon, hammadlik mevarech shalosh, haroe mevarech shetayim. mikkan veelach, madlik mevarech shetayim, veroe mevarech achat.
Umay mevarech: "baruch ... asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehadelik ner (shel) chanukka". vehechan tzivvanu? millo tasur". verav nachman bar yitzchak amar: "sheal avicha veyaggedcha".
(May memaet? — zeman. ema memaet nes? nes kol yoma iteh). rav nachman bar yitzchak matne la behedya, amar rav: kol shiva mitzvat lulav.

Tanu rabbanan: haose sukka leatzmo, omer: "baruch ... shehecheyaynu kulei". nichnas leshev bah, omer: "baruch ... asher kiddeshanu kulei". hayta asuya veomedet, im yachol lechaddesh bah davar — mevarech. im lav, lichsheyyikkanes leshev bah — mevarech shetayim. amar rav ashe: chazena leh lerav kahana dekaamar lehu lechullehu akkasa dekiddusha.

Tanu rabbanan: hayu lefanav mitzvot harebe, omer: "baruch ... asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al hammitzvot". rabbi yehuda omer: mevarech al kol achat veachat bifne atzmah. amar rabbi zera veittema rabbi chanina bar pappa: hilcheta kerabbi yehuda. veamar rabbi zera veittema rabbi chanina bar pappa: may tama derabbi yehuda — dichtiv: "baruch Adonai yom yom", vechi bayyom mevarchin oto, uvallayla en mevarchin oto? ella ba lomar lecha: bechol yom veyom ten lo meen birchotav, hacha name — bechol davar vedavar ten lo meen birchotav.
Veamar rabbi zera veittema rabbi chanina bar pappa: bo uree shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vedam. middat basar vadam — keli rekan
b: Machazik, male — eno machazik. aval middat hakkadosh baruch hu: male — machazik, rekan — eno machazik, shenneemar: "vehaya im shamoa tishma vegomer". "im shamoa" — "tishma". veim lav — lo tishma. davar acher: "im shamoa" — beyashan, "tishma" — bechadash. "veim yifne levavcha" — shuv lo tishma.
Miyyad tinokot vechulei. amar rabbi yochanan: etrog bashshevii — asur, bashshemini — muttar. sukka — afillu bashshemini, asura. veresh lakish amar: etrog — afillu bashshevii name muttar.
Bemay ka mippalgi? mar savar: lemitzvata ittaktzay, umar savar: kulle yoma ittaktzay.
Etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: miyyad tinokot shomtin et lulevehen veochlin etrogehen. may lav, hu haddin ligdolim! la, tinokot davka.

Ikka deamri, etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: miyyad hattinokot shomtin et lulevehen veochlin etrogehen. tinokot — in, gedolim la! hu haddin daafillu gedolim, vehay dekatane tinokot — orcha demilleta katane.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: lerabbi yochanan, may shena sukka, may shena etrog?

Amar leh: sukka dechazya leven hashshemashot, dei itremi leh seodta bae metav begavvav umechal (ba) begavvav, ittaktzay leven hashshemashot, umiggo deittaktzay leven hashshemashot — ittaktzay lechulle yoma dishmini. etrog, dela chaze leven hashshemashot — la ittaktzay leven hashshemashot, vela ittaktzay lechulle yoma dishmini.

Velevi amar: etrog afillu bashshemini asur, vaavu dishmuel amar: etrog bashshevii asur, bashshemini muttar. kam avu dishmuel beshitteh delevi, kam rabbi zera beshitteh daavu dishmuel. deamar rabbi zera: etrog shennifsela — asur leochlah kol shiva.
Amar rabbi zera: la likne inish hoshana leyanoka beyoma tava kamma. may tama? deyanoka mikne kane, aknoye la makne. veishtechach deka nafek belulav sheeno shello.
Veamar rabbi zera: la lema inish leyanoka "deyahevna lach midde" vela yahev leh, mishshum deate leagmoreh shikra, shenneemar: "limmedu leshonam dabber sheker".

Uviflugeta derabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish. deittemar: hifrish shiva etrogin leshiva yamim, amar rav: kol achat veachat yotze bah veochlah lealtar, verav assi amar: kol achat veachat yotze bah veochlah lemachar. bemay ka mippalgi? mar savar: lemitzvata ittaktzay. umar savar: lechulle yoma ittaktzay.
Vaanan deit lan tere yome, hechi avdinan? amar abbaye: shemini sefek shevii — asur, teshii sefek shemini — muttar. marimar amar: afillu shemini sefek shevii — muttar.
Besura avdi kemarimar, rav shisha bereh derav idi aved keabbayye. vehilcheta keabbayye.

Amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav: shemini sefek shevii, shevii lesukka ushemini livracha. verabbi yochanan amar: shemini laze velaze. metav kulle alma la peligi deyatvinan, ki peligi

a: Levaroche. leman deamar shevii lesukka — baroche name mevarchinan, leman deamar shemini laze velaze — baroche la mevarchinan. amar rav yosef: nekot derabbi yochanan beyadcha, derav huna bar bizna vechol gedole haddor ikkelau besukka bishmini sefek shevii. metav havo yatvi, baroche la barichu.
Vedilma sevira lehu keman deamar: kevan shebberach yom tov rishon shuv eno mevarech? gemiri demeafar ato.

Ikka deamri: baroche — kulle alma la peligi dela mevarchinan. ki peligi, lemetav. leman deamar shiva lesukka — metav yatvinan, uleman deamar shemini laze velaze — metav name la yatvinan. amar rav yosef: nekot derabbi yochanan bidach, demara dishmata manni — rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat, uvishmini sefek shevii levar missukka yatev. vehilcheta: metav yatvinan, baroche la mevarchinan.
Amar rabbi yochanan: omrim zeman bishmini shel chag, veen omrim zeman bishvii shel pesach.

Veamar rabbi levi bar chama veittema rabbi chama bar chanina: teda, shehare chaluk bishlosha devarim: besukka, velulav, venissuch hammayim. ulerabbi yehuda deamar: ballog haya menassech kol shemona, hare chaluk bishne devarim.

I hachi, shevii shel pesach name: hare chaluk baachilat matztza! deamar mar: layla rishona — chova, mikkan veelach reshut. hachi hasheta?! hatam — millayla chaluk, miyyom eno chaluk. hacha — afillu miyyom name chaluk.
Ravina amar: ze chaluk mishshellefanav, veze chaluk mishshellifne fanav.
(Amar rav pappa): hacha ketiv "par", hatam ketiv "parim".
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar, hacha ketiv: "bayyom", hatam ketiv: "uvayyom".
Rav ashe amar, hacha ketiv: "kammishpat", hatam ketiv: "kemishpatam".
Lema mesayyay leh: happarim haelim vehakkevasim, meakkevin ze et ze. verabbi yehuda omer: parim en meakkevin ze et ze, shehare mitmaatin veholchin.

Amru lo: vahalo kullan mitmaatin veholchin bashshemini! amar lahen: shemini regel bifne atzmo hu. shekkeshem sheshshivat yeme hachag teunin korban veshir uveracha velina, af shemini taun korban veshir uveracha velina.
b: May lav, zeman? lo, birkat hammazon utefilla.
Hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach zeman — zeman kol shiva mi ikka? ha la kashya: dei la barech haiddana — mevarech limchar, o leyoma acharina.
Mikkol makom kos baenan! lema mesayyay leh lerav nachman, deamar rav nachman: zeman omro afillu bashshuk. dei amrat baenan kos — kos kol yoma mi ikka? dilma deikkela leh kos.

Vesavar rabbi yehuda shemini taun lina? veha tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: minnayin lefesach sheni sheeno taun lina — shenneemar: "ufanita vabboker vehalachta leohalecha", uchetiv: "sheshet yamim tochal matztzot". et shettaun shishsha — taun lina, et sheeno taun shishsha — eno taun lina. lemaote may? lav lemaote name shemini shel chag?
La, lemaote pesach sheni dichvoteh. hachi name mistabbera, ditnan: habbikkurim teunin korban veshir utenufa velina. man shamat leh deamar tenufa — rabbi yehuda, vekaamar: taun lina.
Detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: "vehinnachto" — zo tenufa. atta omer zo tenufa, o eno ella hannacha mammash. keshehu omer "vehinnicho", hare hannacha amur. ha ma ani mekayyem "vehinnachto" — zo tenufa.
Vedilma rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi, detanya: "velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha" — limmed al habbikkurim shetteunin tenufa, divre rabbi eliezer ben yaakov.
May tama derabbi eliezer ben yaakov? atya "yad" "yad" mishshelamim, ketiv hacha: "velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha", uchetiv hatam: "yadav teviena et ishshe Adonai".
Ma kan — kohen, af lehallan — kohen. uma lehallan — bealim, af kan — bealim. ha ketzad? kohen manniach yado tachat yad bealim umenif.
May have ala? rav nachman amar: omrim zeman bishmini shel chag, verav sheshet amar: en omrim zeman bishmini shel chag. vehilcheta: omrim zeman bishmini shel chag.
Tanya kevoteh derav nachman: shemini

a: Regel bifne atzmo leinyan paze"200 keshe"2. payis bifne atzmo. zeman bifne atzmo. regel bifne atzmo. korban bifne atzmo. shira bifne atzmo. beracha bifne atzmo.
Mishna hahallel vehassimcha — shemona. ketzad? melammed shechayyayv adam behallel uvesimcha uvichvod yom tov haacharon shel chag kishar kol yemot hachag.
Gemara mena hane mille — detanu rabbanan: "vehayita ach sameach" — lerabbot lele yom tov haacharon. o eno ella yom tov harishon? keshehu omer "ach" — chillek.
Uma raita lerabbot lele yom tov haacharon ulehotzi lele yom tov harishon? merabbe ani lele yom tov haacharon — sheyyesh simcha lefanav, umotzi ani lele yom tov harishon — sheen simcha lefanav.
Mishna sukka — shiva. ketzad? gamar milleechol — lo yattir et sukkato. aval morid et hakkelim min hammincha ulemala, mippene kevod yom tov haacharon shel chag.

Gemara en lo kelim lehorid, mahu? en lo kelim?! ella ki ishtammash bemay ishtammash? ella: en lo makom lehorid kelav, mahu? rabbi chiyyay bar (rav) amar: pochet bah arbaa. verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: madlik bah et hanner.
Vela peligi: ha lan veha lehu.
Ha tinach sukka ketanna, sukka gedola may ikka lememar? dimayyel ba mane mechla. deamar rava: mane mechla — bar mimmetallalta. mane mishteya — bimtallalta.

Mishna nissuch hammayim ketzad? tzelochit shel zahav machzeket shelosha luggim haya memalle min hashshiloach. higgiu leshaar hammayim, taku veheriu vetaku. ala bakkevesh ufana lismolo, shene sefalim shel kesef hayu sham. rabbi yehuda omer: shel sid hayu, ella shehayu mushecharin penehem mippene hayyayin. umenukkavin
b: Kemin shene chotamin dakkin, (veechad) meubbe veechad dak, kede sheyyehu shenehem kalin bevat achat. maaravo — shel mayim, mizracho — shel yayin. era shel mayim letoch shel yayin, veshel yayin letoch shel mayim — yatza.
Rabbi yehuda omer: ballog haya menassech kol shemona. velamnassech omer lo: hageba yadecha. sheppaam echad nissech echad al gabbe raglav, uregamuhu kol haam beetrogehen.

Kemaasehu bachol kach maasehu bashshabbat, ella shehaya memalle meerev shabbat chavit shel zahav sheenah mekuddeshet min hashshiloach umannichah ballishka. nishpecha, nitgalleta, haya memalle min hakkiyyor. shehayyayin vehammayim megullin — pesulin legabbe mizbeach.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rav ena, deamar kera: "usheavtem mayim besason vegomer".

Hanhu tere mine, chad shemeh sason vechad shemeh simcha. amar leh sason lesimcha: ana adifna minnach, dichtiv: "sason vesimcha yassigu vegomer". amar leh simcha lesason: ana adifna minnach, dichtiv: "simcha vesason layyehudim". amar leh sason lesimcha: chad yoma shavkuch veshavveyuch parvavnka, dichtiv: "ki vesimcha tetzeu". amar leh simcha lesason: chad yoma shavkuch umalu bach mayya, dichtiv: "usheavtem mayim besason".

Amar leh hahu mina dishmeh sason lerabbi avahu: atiditu ditmallo li mayim lealma deate, dichtiv: "usheavtem mayim besason", amar leh: i hava ketiv "lesason" — kidkaamrat, hasheta dichtiv "besason" — mashkeh dehahu gavra meshavvenan leh goda umalenan beh mayya.

Ala bakkevesh ufana lismolo kulei. tanu rabbanan: kol haolim lemizbeach — olin derech yamin umakkifin veyordin derech semol. chutz min haole lishlosha devarim hallalu, sheolin derech semol vechozrin al heakev. veellu hen: nissuch hammayim, venissuch hayyayin, veolat haof kesheravta bammizrach.
Ella, shehayu mashchirin. bishlama deyayin mashchir, demayya ammay mashchir? kevan deamar mar: era shel mayim letoch shel yayin, veshel yayin letoch shel mayim yatza — shel mayim ate leashchore.
Umenukkavim kemin shene chotamin vechulei. lema matnitin rabbi yehuda hi vela rabbanan, ditnan: rabbi yehuda omer: ballog haya menassech kol shemona. dei rabbanan, — ki hadade ninhu!
Afillu tema rabbanan: chamra semich, mayya kelish.

Hachi name mistabbera, dei rabbi yehuda — "rachav" vekatzar" it leh. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: shene kasvoot hayu sham, echad shel mayim veechad shel yayin. shel yayin — piha rachav, shel mayim — piha katzar, kede sheyyehu shenehem kalin bevat achat, shema minna.

Maaravo shel mayim. tanu rabbanan: maase betzadduki echad shennissech al gabbe raglav, uregamuhu kol haam beetrogehen. veoto hayyom nifgema keren hammizbeach, veheviu bul shel melach usetamuhu. lo mippene shehucheshar laavoda, ella mippene shello yerae mizbeach pagum.

a: Shekkol mizbeach sheen lo lo kevesh velo keren velo yesod velo ribbua — pasul laavoda. rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: af hassovev.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: shitin, mishsheshet yeme bereshit nivreu, shenneemar: "chammuke yerechayich kemo chalaim maase yede omman". "chamuke yerechayich" — ellu hashshitin. "kemo chalaim" — shemmechollin veyordin ad hattehom. "maase yede omman" — zo maase yede ummanuto shel hakkadosh baruch hu. tana deve rabbi yishmael: "bereshit", al tikre "bereshit", ella "bara shit".

Tanya, rabbi yose omer: shittin mecholalin veyordin ad tehom, shenneemar: "ashira na lididi shirat dodi lecharmo kerem haya lididi bekeren ben shamen. vayazzekehu vaysakkelehu vayyittaehu sorek vayyiven migdal betocho vegam yekev chatzev bo". "vayyittaehu sorek" — ze bet hammikdash, "vayyiven migdal betocho" — ze mizbeach, "vegam yekev chatzev bo" — ellu hashshitin.

Tanya, amar rabbi elazar bar tzadok: lul katan haya ben kevesh lammizbeach bemaaravo shel kevesh, veachat leshivim shana pirche chehunna yordin lesham, umelakketin mishsham yayin karush sheddome leiggule devela, uvain vesorfin oto bikdushsha, shenneemar: "bakkodesh hassech nesech shechar laAdonai" —
b: Keshem shennissucho bikdushsha, kach serefato bikdushsha. may mashma? amar ravina: atya "kodesh" "kodesh". ketiv hacha: "bakkodesh hassech nesech", uchetiv hatam: "vesarafta et hannotar baesh lo yeachel ki kodesh hu".
Keman azla ha (detanya): nesachim, battechilla moalin bahen. yardu lashshitin — en moalin bahen. lema rabbi elazar bar tzadok hi, dei rabbanan, ha nachatu lehu lithom!
Afillu tema rabbanan, bidikkelat.

Veikka deamri: lema rabbanan hi, vela rabbi elazar bar tzadok? dei rabbi elazar, akkatti bikdushetayyhu kayymi! afillu tema rabbi elazar, en lecha davar shennaasa mitzvato umoalin bo. amar resh lakish: bizman shemmenassechin yayin al gabbe mizbeach, pokkin et hashshitin. lekayyem ma shenneemar: "bakkodesh hassech nesech shechar laAdonai".

May mashma? amar rav pappa: "shechar" — leshon shetiyya, leshon sevia, leshon shichrut. amar rav pappa: shema minna ki sava inish chamra — miggeroneh sava. amar rava: tzureba merabbanan dela nefisho leh chamra, ligamma gammoe. rava akkasa devirketa agma gammoe.

Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "ma yafu feamayich bannealim bat nadiv" — ma yafu paamotehen shel yisrael beshaa sheolin laregel. "bat nadiv" — bitto shel avraham avinu shennikra nadiv, shenneemar: "nedive ammim neesafu am elohe avraham". "elohe avraham", velo elohe yitzchak veyaakov?! ella: "elohe avraham", shehaya techilla legerim.
Tana deve rav anan, may dichtiv: "chammuke yerechayich" — lamma nimshelu divre tora keyarech? lomar lach: ma yarech basseter, af divre tora basseter.
