Vehayeynu deamar rabbi elazar, may dichtiv: "higgid lecha adam ma tov uma Adonai doresh mimmecha ki im asot mishpat veahavat chesed vehatzenea lechet im elohecha". "asot mishpat" — ze haddin, "veahavat chesed" — zo gemilut chasadim, "vehatzenea lechet im elohecha" — zo hotzaat hammet vehachenasat kalla lachuppa. vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma devarim sheddarkan laasotan befarhesya, amra tora "hatzenea lechet", devarim sheddarkan laasotan betzina — al achat kamma vechamma.

Amar rabbi elazar: gadol haose tzedaka yoter mikkol hakkarbanot, shenneemar: "aso tzedaka umishpat nivchar laAdonai mizzavach". veamar rabbi elazar: gedola gemilut chasadim yoter min hatztzedaka, shenneemar: "ziru lachem litzdaka vekitzru lefi chesed". im adam zorea — safek ochel safek eno ochel, adam kotzer — vadday ochel.
Veamar rabbi elazar: en tzedaka mishtallemet ella lefi chesed shebbah, shenneemar: "ziru lachem litzdaka vekitzru lefi chesed".

Tanu rabbanan: bishlosha devarim gedola gemilut chasadim yoter min hatztzedaka. tzedaka — bemamono; gemilut chasadim — ben begufo, ben bemamono. tzedaka — laaniyyim; gemilut chasadim — ben laaniyyim ben laashirim. tzedaka — lachayyim; gemilut chasadim — ben lachayyim ben lammetim.

Veamar rabbi elazar: kol haose tzedaka umishpat, keillu mille kol haolam kullo chesed. shenneemar: "ohev tzedaka umishpat chesed Adonai mala haaretz". shemma tomar kol habba likpotz kofetz, talmud lomar: "ma yakar chasdecha elohim (chesed Adonai mala haaretz) vegomer". yachol af yere shamayim ken — talmud lomar: "vechesed Adonai meolam vead olam al yereav".

Amar rabbi chama bar pappa: kol adam sheyyesh alav chen, beyadua shehu yere shamayim, shenneemar: "chesed Adonai meolam vead olam al yereav". veamar rabbi elazar, may dichtiv: "piha patcha vechachma vetorat chesed al leshonah", vechi yesh tora shel chesed veyesh tora sheenah shel chesed? ella: tora lishmah — zo hi tora shel chesed, shello lishmah — zo hi tora sheenah shel chesed. ikka deamri: tora lelammedah — zo hi tora shel chesed, shello lelammedah — zo hi tora sheenah shel chesed.
Kemaasehu bachol kulei. veammay? nayyte bimkuddeshet! amar zeeri: kasavar en shiur lammayim, uchele sharet mekaddeshin shello middaat.

a: Vei mayyte bimkuddeshet, ippesilu lehu belina. chizkiyya amar: kele sharet en mekaddeshin ella middaat, ugezera shemma yomru ledaat nitkaddeshu.
Amar rabbi yannay amar rabbi zera: afillu tema yesh shiur lammayim, uchele sharet en mekaddeshin ella middaat, ugezera shemma yomru lekiddush yadayim veraglayim millean.

Nishpecha o nitgalleta kulei. veammay? liabbayr bimsannenet. lema matnitin dela kerabbi nechemya, detanya: mesannenet yesh bah mishshum gilluy. amar rabbi nechemya: ematay — bizman shehattachtona megulla, aval bizman shehattachtona mechussa, af al pi shehaelyona megulla — en bah mishshum gilluy. mippene sheeres nachash dome lisfog tzaf veomed bimkomo.
Afillu tema rabbi nechemya, emar deamar rabbi nechemya lehedyot, aval legavoah mi amar? velet leh lerabbi nechemya: "hakerivehu na lefechatecha hayirtzecha o hayissa fanecha amar Adonai tzevaot"?!
Hadaran alach lulav vaarava
Hechalil — chamishsha veshishsha. zehu hechalil shel bet hashshoeva, sheeno doche lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov.
b: Gemara ittemar: rav yehuda verav ena, chad tane: shoeva, vechad tane: chashuva. amar mar zutera: man detane shoeva la mishtabbash, uman detane chashuva la mishtabbash. man detane shoeva la mishtabbash, dichtiv: "usheavtem mayim besason". uman detane chashuva la mishtabbash, deamar rav nachman: mitzva chashuva hi, uvaa mishsheshet yeme bereshit.

Tanu rabbanan: hechalil doche et hashshabbat, divre rabbi yose bar yehuda. vachachamim omrim: af yom tov eno doche. amar rav yosef: machloket beshir shel korban, derabbi yose savar: ikkar shira bichli, vaavoda hi, vedocha et hashshabbat. verabbanan savri: ikkar shira bappe, velav avoda hi, veenah docha et hashshabbat. aval shir shel shoeva, divre hakkol simcha hi, veenah docha et hashshabbat.

Amar rav yosef: mena amena divha peligi, detanya: kele sharet sheasaan shel etz, rabbi posel verabbi yose bar yehuda machshir. may lav beha kamippalgi, man demachshayr savar: ikkar shira bichli, veyalfinan meabbuva demoshe. uman defasel savar: ikkar shira bappe, vela yalfinan meabbuva demoshe.
La, dechulle alma ikkar shira bichli, vehacha bedanin efshar mishshei efshar kamippalgi. man demachshayr savar: danin efshar mishshei efshar, uman defasel savar: la danin efshar mishshei efshar.

Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma deikkar shira bappe, veen danin efshar mishshei efshar, vehacha bemelaf menora bichlale uferate o beribbuye umiute ka mippalgi. rabbi daresh kelale uferate, rabbi yose bar yehuda daresh ribbuye umiute.

Rabbi daresh kelale uferate: "veasita menorat" — kalal, "zahav tahor" — parat, "miksha tease hammenora" — chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal, i atta dan ella keen happerat. ma happerat meforash shel mattechet, af kol shel mattechet.

Rabbi yose bar yehuda, daresh ribbuye umiute: "veasita menorat" — ribba, "zahav tahor" — miet, "miksha tease hamenora" — chazar veribba, ribba umiet veribba — ribba hakkol. may rabbi — rabbi kol mille, may mayet — mayet shel cheres.
